chapter_title: The Interpretation of Happiness, Wisdom and Power; what they signify.
chapter_note: The chapter’s core substrate is a systematic five-fold correspondential schema mapping “happiness / wisdom / power” across successive cosmic levels (Land of Light → Sun/ship of living fire → ship of living waters → elements). The opening paragraphs are a dialogue/topic-introduction frame. After the four cosmic iterations, an editor adds an institutional extension (“Now, moreover… in the holy church”), matching the prior syntactic pattern but shifting Side-B of the mapping from cosmos→church; the final line then closes with a beatitude-style exhortation.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic hagiographic opening (“Once again… speaks to his disciples… assembly of the church”).
Topic-question and contrast with ‘the world’ without cosmological mapping; functions as introductory dialogue framing rather than the impersonal correspondential substrate.
Continuation of introductory setup (“People boast… Now… is revealed… as I have told you”) in a discourse-address register, not systematic cosmos→cosmos mapping.
Direct address (“listen that I may reveal to you”) introducing the schema; not itself the substrate’s structural mapping layer.

paragraphs.core_text: [The happin]ess of the glorious one is the Father, the God of [truth, who] is established in the great land of [light]. His glorious wis[d]om is his Great Spirit that [ ... ] below, which flows through all his aeons, and t[h]ey float therein. His great power is all the gods, the rich ones and the angels who were summoned from him as they [ ... ] t]hey that are called aeons [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic correspondential identification of the triad within the highest cosmic domain (Father / Great Spirit / gods-angels-aeons). Impersonal expository voice; cosmos→cosmos mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... ] which is called] the sun [ ... the ship of] living fire, [ ... the Third Amba]ssador, the second greatne[ss ... The] glorious [happiness] is the [Living] Spirit, [ ... , the wisdom] is the Mother of Lif[e ... and great power] is [all] the gods, [the] rich o]nes and the angels who are within the ship.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second iteration of the same triadic mapping, now within the sun/ship of living fire; named cosmological beings (Third Ambassador, Living Spirit, Mother of Life) in a fixed structural pattern.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, [h]appiness, wisdom and power exist in the s[hip of liv]ing waters [ ... ] the happiness [ ... ] the Mind of the Father. Also, wisdom [is the Vir]gi]n of [Li]ght. And the power that is [i]n the ship is [all] the go[ds], the [ri]ch ones and the angels who are established i[n it].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third iteration (“Again… exist in…”) continuing the cosmological series with stable, list-like correspondential identifications; no institutional anchoring.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, these three exist in the elements: happiness, wis[d]o]m and power. The happiness is [the Pillar of Glory], the Perfect Man. Wisdom is the [five sons of the] Living Spirit; and great powe[r is ... the fi]ve sons of the First Man [ ... who are encl]osed and compounded in the totality, that [ ... ] while he supports the totality.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth iteration situating the triad in the mixed cosmos (“elements”), still mapping cosmic entity→cosmic function/degree (Pillar of Glory/Perfect Man; five sons of Living Spirit; five sons of First Man).

Editorial seam: bridge connective “Now, moreover” extends the prior ‘Again… exist in…’ pattern but shifts mapping Side-B to institutional identities (holy church, Apostle of Light, leaders/teachers, elect/catechumens). By rule, the whole paragraph is a later pastoral graft, not MIXED.

Beatitude/exhortation-style closure (“Blessed… is every one who will know…”) and ‘five churches’ summary-language functioning as an editorial wrap-up after the institutional seam; not impersonal substrate exposition.
